title: The Rose
lrc:
[00:05.96] Some say love, it is a river
[00:16.25] That drowns the tender reed
[00:20.74] Some say love, it is a razor
[00:27.77] That leaves your soul to bleed
[00:35.80] Some say love, it is a hunger
[00:43.62] An endless aching need
[00:51.36] I say love, it is a flower
[01:00.96] And you, its only seed
[01:11.90] It's the heart, afraid of breaking
[01:19.50] That never learns to dance
[01:26.86] It's the dream, afraid of waking
[01:33.18] That never takes the chance
[01:40.14] It's the one who won't be taken
[01:47.98] Who cannot seem to give
[01:55.92] And the soul, afraid of dying
[02:03.62] That never learns to live
[02:14.20] When the night has been too lonely
[02:20.68] And the road has been too long
[02:29.27] And you think that love is only
[02:35.95] For the lucky and the strong
[02:41.59] Just remember in the winter
[02:49.35] Far beneath the bitter snows
[02:56.01] Lies the seed that with the sun's love
[03:04.59] In the spring becomes the rose
